title: Is Lionel Messi the Greatest of All Time?
description:
Eight Ballons d'Or. Six European Golden Shoes. A record 474 La Liga goals and 73 in a single season. Two trebles. The 2022 World Cup. Is Lionel Messi the greatest of all time? You decide. Career facts and season-by-season goals from Wikipedia; in a limited sample of StatsBomb event data (12 Barcelona league starts in 2009/10 and 12 in 2018/19) his key passes per 90 minutes rose from 1.4 to 3.5. All photographs are from Wikimedia Commons, credited in the video.
